records: Coinbase's collateral disclosures have nested and overlapping views. The USD301.943M recognized derivatives collateral is included within the USD1.2995B balance-sheet crypto-collateral total. The USD434.163M company-owned short-term borrowing pledge is a separate encumbrance view and may overlap with recognized balance-sheet collateral; do not add it without a mapping. The USD3.284562B customer collateral not recognized is separate. No XRP-specific amount is disclosed.
